title: The signature board problem — find the other five

board_content.text: Example 1 — sin x = 3/5, x in Quadrant II
The sign decision is the whole question. In Quadrant II, cosine is negative.
Writing cos x = +4/5 here is the most common board mistake.

segments_english.text: This is the problem that appears on nearly every board paper, so do it cleanly.

Given sine x is three fifths with x in the second quadrant. Do magnitude first: cosine squared x is one minus nine over twenty five, which is sixteen over twenty five, so cosine x is plus or minus four fifths.
Now the part that is the entire question, the sign. x is in Quadrant two, where cosine is negative. So we take the minus.

Cosine x is minus four fifths. From there, tangent is sine over cosine, minus three quarters; cotangent minus four thirds; secant minus five fourths; and cosecant, the reciprocal of sine, is plus five thirds.
A quick quadrantal one to warm the axis values.
Sine of three pi over two is minus one; cosine of pi is minus one; tangent of pi is zero. So minus one plus minus one minus zero gives minus two.
The single most common board mistake in this whole topic is writing cosine x as plus four fifths, skipping the quadrant. Magnitude, then sign, always two steps.

segments_hinglish.text: ये problem लगभग हर board paper पर आता है, so इसे साफ़ कीजिए.
दिया है sine x तीन बटा पाँच, x second quadrant में. पहले magnitude: cosine squared x है one minus nine over twenty five, यानी sixteen over twenty five, so cosine x है plus or minus four fifths.
अब वो हिस्सा जो पूरा सवाल है, sign. x Quadrant two में है, जहाँ cosine negative है. So हम minus लेते हैं.
Cosine x है minus four fifths. वहाँ से tangent है sine over cosine, minus three quarters; cotangent minus four thirds; secant minus five fourths; और cosecant, sine का reciprocal, plus five thirds.
एक quick quadrantal, axis values गरम करने के लिए.
Sine of three pi over two है minus one; cosine of pi minus one; tangent of pi zero. So minus one plus minus one minus zero देता है minus two.
पूरे topic की सबसे common board mistake है cosine x को plus four fifths लिखना, quadrant छोड़कर. Magnitude, फिर sign, हमेशा दो steps.
